HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
Election under Section 83(b) of the Internal Revenue Code
Taxpayer: Jane Doe, 100 Example Street, Example City, Colorado. Taxpayer number
masked in this sample.
Property: 613,240 shares of common stock of Harbor Labs, Inc.
Date of transfer: June 7, 2011. Taxable year: 2011.
Restrictions: the shares are subject to the company's repurchase right in the Stock
Agreement.
Fair market value at transfer: $0.0125 per share, $7,665.50 in total.
Amount paid: $7,665.50. Amount included in gross income: $0.00.
Signed under penalties of perjury by Jane Doe on June 19, 2011.

HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 2 of 2
Proof of mailing
Certified mail receipt: mailed June 20, 2011 to the Internal Revenue Service in
Ogden, Utah.
The thirtieth day after the June 7, 2011 transfer is July 7, 2011.
A copy was given to the company on June 21, 2011 and is kept with the stock records.
